prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut demi statue portrait, five-material body (asymmetric), every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh-stub tips just below her hip line, where the two thighs have only just begun to separate, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Chinese woman in Hong Kong-style makeup — fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, hair set in glossy voluminous old-film waves, a poised, glamorous expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a large vintage pearl clip earring.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest, a cinched waist above a big soft rounded belly and enormous round hips, her left arm crystal, her right arm carved stone, her torso a glass vessel, her thigh-stub-stubs vessel and wood.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent deep ruby-red cast glass, one continuous carved mass, never hollow. Light passes straight through it. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid bright blue-green amazonite streaked with white feldspar, completely opaque, completely opaque. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (chest, belly, hips): a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled completely to the brim with clear clear amethyst-violet water with soft drifting moonbeams, no hollow space, no air gap. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through it, rising to the collarbone line itself.

Left thigh-stub (hip to tip): a small sculpted vessel of clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled with clear topaz-gold water with drifting light. Just below her hip line, where the two thighs have only just begun to separate, her left thigh-stub curves inward and seals shut into its own small, smooth, rounded, closed tip — the vessel simply reaching its natural end there. Right thigh-stub (hip to tip): carved from ONE solid block of richly streaked cream, rose-pink and violet Brazilian tulipwood, completely opaque, completely opaque. Just below her hip line, where the two thighs have only just begun to separate, her right thigh-stub curves inward and rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip — the wood simply reaching its natural end there.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a soft cream white on one side and a deep crimson red on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so white light glances off one side and red light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
